instructions: Paths are relative to this input document, or absolute. Duplicate this file and the session log; retain originals.
Set capture_session_file to the completed measured session log. This tool supports checkerboards only; ChArUco requires a different detector.
Record actual measured x/y square pitch in session.target.square_pitch_measured_xy_m, dimensional method/uncertainty, and native camera source size/settings.

For each capture, supply exactly one native source_image_file+SHA256, or source_video_file+SHA256+zero-based source_frame_index. Video frame index is presentation/decode order from the start of the source file.
Declare at least six fit views from three whole capture groups and two independent verification capture groups before running detection. Every group's role must match the camera session split.
No frame is silently replaced on detection or quality failure. Original source frames and all detections/errors remain in a fresh output directory.
Optics output is a candidate only. Camera/base, joint-zero and gripper/contact acceptance require the separate measured registration workflow.
